activity.notes: Godred Crovan appears in the Irish annals as king of Dublin in 1091 and was expelled from Dublin by Muirchertach Ua Briain's forces in 1094. ATLAS records this Dublin kingship separately from his existing Kingdom of Mann and the Isles reign.

sources.title: Godred Crovan and the Irish Sea world — Trinity College Dublin thesis
sources.citation_text: The Trinity College Dublin thesis notes Godred's first appearance in Dublin in 1091 as king of Dublin and his expulsion from Dublin in 1094.

sources.title: Lords of the Isles — Oxford Academic
sources.citation_text: Oxford describes Godred Crovan as briefly adding Dublin to his domain in the late eleventh century.
